bibl.title: Florentine papyri under examination: the material study of the inks used at the beginning of the common era at the kôm Kâssûm near Hermopolis
bibl.seg: Francesca Maltomini, Tea Ghigo, Oliver Hahn & Ira Rabin, Florentine papyri under examination: the material study of inks used at the beginning of the Common Era in the "Family of Kôm Kâssûm" Archive (Hermopolis).
bibl.note: Introduction. - Experimental part. - Handling of the papyri. - Results. - Conclusion. "Carbon inks ranging from pure to mixed ones with different metallic admixtures co-existed in Egypt during the 1st to 2nd century CE."
